response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates excellent technical depth and some developer tools experience, this is a management role requiring 2+ years of formal people management—entirely absent from the resume. The required 3 years of focused developer tools/build systems experience is also not clearly demonstrated; infrastructure and tooling contributions are scattered across roles rather than concentrated. He would be better positioned for a Staff/Principal Engineer role and could potentially transition to management after gaining direct people leadership experience.
strengths: Deep technical expertise across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded, backend) and programming languages with demonstrated system design and architecture capabilities
Developer tools and testing framework contributions (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts) plus infrastructure/DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitLab administration, and build tooling
Strong culture of teaching and mentoring evidenced by multiple workshops, courses (Selenium, Web Internals), and knowledge-sharing initiatives, indicating potential for people development
concerns: No formal people management or direct line management experience—a critical and explicitly required qualification for this manager-level role
Developer tools and build systems experience is scattered across multiple roles rather than demonstrating the required focused 3+ year concentration in this specialized domain
Lacks evidence of strategic planning, organizational change leadership, performance management, cross-functional team direction-setting, or other key manager responsibilities
